author: Director
question: Does bounded pretranslation repartition improve ownership of uniquely GT-attributable accepted text across distinct meeting speaker groups without increasing severe ownership errors, losing text, or violating Audio lifecycle and deadline rules?
claim_population: Authoritative accepted ASR text attributable to a unique GT speaker under the frozen temporal attribution rule, from the full declared English AMI Mix-Headset meetings with Deepgram Nova-3 English streaming and continuous Sortformer F16. Overlap-unassessable, unaligned and other unsupported text remains counted but is not assigned an invented point score. This conditional effect is not an all-accepted-text, end-to-end lossless, target-device, language-general, pretraining-unseen or production-wide efficacy claim.

execution_location.contract: Build a local capsule from pinned Audio source, prompts and test support, overlaid with this worktree's canonical experiment code and tests. U13 additionally permits a hash-pinned override of the existing Audio pretranslation ownership module and applicable tests through the same overlay mechanism. Keep target product src, archive bytes and the retired Audio worktree untouched; no duplicate harness-side policy.
execution_location.cash_journal: experiments/psem_r2_policy/artifacts/budget_ledger.json in experiment v2 is the sole execution journal; preserve all 822 historical entries and the USD0.106012876 OpenRouter reservation. A capsule-local copy is never an independent spending authority.
execution_location.preserved: Relocation changes execution packaging only, not the policy, sample, primary estimator, guard definitions, providers, prompt, source deadlines or paid/HOLDOUT gates.

hypotheses.primary: Conditional on authoritative nonempty accepted ASR text uniquely attributable to a GT speaker, including admitted degraded prefixes where scorable, R2 reduces equal-speaker-cluster-weighted cross-speaker contamination compared with R0 on sequential transitions. Unsupported overlap text remains in coverage and conservative sensitivity, not an invented point score.
hypotheses.safety: R2 does not introduce severe wrong ownership, text loss or duplication in predefined guards; uncertainty and fragmentation remain visible costs.
hypotheses.mechanism: Benefits require a confirmed event received before actual translation-unit admission, not retrospective access to unavailable evidence.

providers.asr: Deepgram Nova-3 English streaming, mono linear16 at 16kHz; native diarization and paid add-ons disabled; local ASR prohibited without subsequent user approval
providers.translation: google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it via existing OpenRouter adapter, en to ko; same pinned prompt and route for both arms
providers.translation_context: Fixed empty context and no scene participant count for both arms on every parent; no evolving translation-history context in this experiment
providers.speaker: Existing continuous native Sortformer 4spk v2.1 F16, threshold 0.5, confirmation 1600 source samples, no model training

arms.R0: Existing real C5-sealed Audio path with no PSEM intervention
arms.R2: Same PCM and accepted Deepgram text as R0. U13 coverage-gated candidate: at actual translation admission, partition only when causally delivered valid evidence covers the authoritative parent source span required for partitioning and valid confirmed local transitions support the cuts. Otherwise preserve the original R0-equivalent whole-parent unit, not partially split unsupported residuals. Preserve one sealed parent, exact accepted text and token identities; unknown or overlap support never force-assigns a speaker. No additional waiting or retrospective evidence.
arms.R1_diagnostic: Prospective C13 requests on the same frozen accepted-text record; actionability diagnostic only, not a claim of actual changed-PCM recognition or translation effect.
arms.correct_transition_control: Annotation-correct local transitions charged at the actual receipt of the first causally covering producer chunk; same application cutoff; unreachable hindsight is never counted.

policy_selection: R2 remains the single confirmatory candidate. DEV may repair implementation defects and establish timing/provenance validity, not sweep thresholds or wait durations. Operational expiry/empty/failure alone no longer blocks policy evaluation when the complete source and every formed parent remain accounted. Safety failure, invalid capture/provenance, or no relevant correct-control headroom still stops HOLDOUT. A new hybrid or alternative requires a named Director revision before HOLDOUT inspection.

u13_policy_revision.history: User authorized repair after the old R2 policy failed the severe grouping gate on ES2009d. Old policy remains failed, not retroactively passed. Director selects one conservative coverage-gated alternative before any HOLDOUT inspection; no threshold or wait sweep.
u13_policy_revision.causality: U13-COVERAGE-2 clarification after independent review: coverage is the union of real observed native source-frame support with actual receipt timestamps and applicable generation/reference validity, not the sparse event/exception channel that omits steady frames. All coverage and event facts must be available at actual admission. Preserve holes, late data and identity uncertainty; a maximum frontier or fabricated per-word evidence cannot establish observation coverage. Runtime policy must not consume GT annotations.
u13_policy_revision.anti_gaming: No token-specific exception, GT-derived boundary, universal singleton partition, unconditional R2 disabling or oracle relaxation. Fully supported confirmed transitions retain useful partitioning. Report abstention, lost intervention opportunities, fragmentation and any remaining severe errors.
u13_policy_revision.probe: Use preserved complete ES2009a/c/d records to reproduce old-policy units at the true admission cutoff and evaluate the candidate with the unchanged external oracle. Feed recorded native frames through the actual producer path with original receipt/order and live owner retention semantics; obtain the old module from the hash-pinned in-repository archive. Report fidelity, missing metadata, full-parent coverage, supported partitions and all errors. Demonstrate both genuinely covered native-path splitting and late/incomplete abstention; synthetic per-word coverage alone is not evidence of native-path utility.
u13_policy_revision.evidence_reuse: Preserve all original acquisitions and old-policy verdicts. Unchanged accepted text, R0, source accounting and causal native receipt traces may support offline probes. New R2 units, translations, fragmentation and timing require new-policy evidence. Do not reuse changed-unit translations or mix policy revisions. Offline regrouping is not actual live latency/admission evidence.
u13_policy_revision.barrier: Paid execution remains closed through implementation, causal probe and independent integrated review. Reassess required actual translation/live checks before resumption. Full 5 DEV / 10 HOLDOUT and all safety/headroom/budget gates remain required.

u14_source_tail_repair.scope: Repair generic harness EOF processing to satisfy the existing full-source contract; U13-COVERAGE-2 ownership policy, U10-GUARD-3, sample, provider/native cadence, thresholds and added wait remain unchanged.
u14_source_tail_repair.behavior: A nonempty residual PCM buffer must pass through the existing fixed-size VAD path even when VAD is not currently in speech. Zero-pad only to the required frame boundary and account those zeros separately as flush_pad_source_samples, never as real fed input. Empty buffers emit no frame; aligned input and existing in-speech flush/hangover behavior remain unchanged.
u14_source_tail_repair.integrity: Do not suppress dropped-tail errors, trim source, replace delivery with counters or fabricate native evidence/source time. Preserve real EOF and synthetic processing distinctions and normal VAD/admission/retirement behavior.
u14_source_tail_repair.history_and_reuse: ES2002b U13 attempt-1 actually dropped 171 real samples and remains invalid; post-hoc rescoring cannot recover unprocessed audio. Current-policy ES2009a/c/d attempt-2 input lengths are frame aligned and never entered this residual branch; their live evidence remains reusable if the reviewed delta leaves those paths unchanged. EN2009d remains unstarted.
u14_source_tail_repair.architecture: The experiment requires stricter full-source observation than the immutable product runtime's in-speech-only EOF tail handling. Apply the narrow fix in canonical harness live_runner.py; do not alter the product src, Audio archive, ownership policy or scorer.
u14_source_tail_repair.gate: Paid execution stays closed through focused fail-before/pass-after delivery proof, applicable capsule tests/smoke and independent review. Only a separately authorized repaired ES2002b attempt and remaining EN2009d may follow; preserve the three applicable current-policy successes and all invalid history.

development.regime: Full available continuous recordings through the actual C5 Audio controller and Deepgram adapter. Historical Soniox captures are reference only, not this provider DEV data.
development.source_history: Start each source at its genuine beginning with explicit initial unknown/reference state; do not reset PSEM at logical seals or reuse future history.

holdout.regime: Full continuous recording per speaker cluster, approximately 3.55 hours total; same pipeline and candidate as DEV
holdout.interpretation: All ten are held out from this policy development, but four are not historically untouched. Report the six-source subset separately. Sortformer pretraining contamination remains unknown.
holdout.lock: Hash audio, annotation versions, speaker-cluster membership, policy code/config and metric definitions before first HOLDOUT inference. No tuning, source replacement, outcome-based exclusion or optional stopping after unblinding. Budget or runtime truncation is an incomplete evaluation, not a smaller passing sample.

stratum_assignment: Annotation and lifecycle definitions fixed before model results. Natural strata retain full counts; synthetic gap, duplicate, cancellation and exact-deadline probes are reported separately and never inflate natural sample size.

measurements.unit: Authoritative accepted text with real timing/provenance, from complete parents or admitted degraded prefixes. Point scoring requires paired R0/R2 records and unique GT attribution; measured overlap-unassessable text remains a recorded coverage unit outside point scoring, not a zero-error observation.
measurements.primary: For each eligible cluster, proportion of attributable accepted lexical text incorrectly merged across a sequential speaker boundary; report R2 minus R0. Equal cluster weighting, not word-pooled pseudo-replication.
measurements.uncertainty: Paired cluster bootstrap 95% interval with 10000 resamples and seed 156; exact per-cluster deltas, eligible counts and leave-one-cluster-out sensitivity. If fewer than eight eligible clusters, the confirmatory result is inconclusive, not a relaxed pass.
measurements.coverage: Report every formed parent, every accepted character including unaligned/mixed/UNKNOWN, and source consumption. Expired, empty, failed and cancelled outcomes are not zero-contamination observations. Retain existing newly-unassigned-text harm bounds and add the preregistered selection sensitivity below.
measurements.conservation: Exact ordered reconstruction of normalized accepted text per immutable parent; missing and duplicate spans independently counted
measurements.fragmentation: Ownership children per parent, singleton fragments and extra splits on same-speaker guards
measurements.latency: Monotonic actual source support, producer completion, receipt, recognition terminal, partition, translation admission, dispatch and completion; p50/p95/max added partition/admission delay and actual C5 deadline violations
measurements.translation: OFF and R2 traverse the actual fixed translation adapter with the same request configuration. Source ownership is primary; do not claim semantic translation-quality improvement solely from more output children. Preserve outputs for blinded paired inspection under a fixed rubric and report subjective assessments separately.

translation_rubric.unit: One immutable accepted-text parent; retained R0 response versus new U15 R2 responses joined in original child/source order. Accepted ASR text is the reference, not a claim of perfect transcription.
translation_rubric.blinding: Candidates A/B in deterministic shuffled order using seed156; keep arm/acquisition mapping outside the inspection view and preserve raw child outputs. Preparing the view produces no ratings or semantic efficacy claim.
translation_rubric.coverage: Keep every parent/request in the census. Missing response, failed call or source_only makes complete paired semantic assessment unavailable with a visible reason. Successful empty responses remain verbatim and may be assessed for omission, not fabricated as missing responses.
translation_rubric.adequacy: 0 central meaning absent/wrong; 1 major meaning omitted/altered; 2 main meaning preserved with minor omissions; 3 all meaningful source content preserved.
translation_rubric.faithfulness: 0 central unsupported content/contradiction; 1 substantial unsupported additions; 2 minor unsupported detail; 3 no unsupported content. Fluent hallucination earns no credit here.
translation_rubric.fluency: 0 not understandable Korean; 1 difficult to understand; 2 understandable but awkward; 3 natural understandable Korean.
translation_rubric.assessment_record: Record dimensions separately, A/B/tie/unassessable preference, rater identity and short source-grounded reasons. No fabricated ratings, unregistered composite efficacy score or quality inference from more children. Subjective results remain separate from ownership and failure coverage.

conditional_evaluation.agreement: U10: user selected separation of overlap-unassessable text and explicit restriction of the effect population to uniquely GT-attributable accepted text, with unassessable coverage and conservative sensitivity. Original full recordings, 5 DEV / 10 HOLDOUT and actual error gates remain required.
conditional_evaluation.primary_pool: Sequential paired-scorable authoritative nonempty accepted text from complete or degraded parents, with unique GT attribution. Pool contaminated/attributable accepted lexical characters within each fixed speaker cluster, then weight eligible clusters equally. Computed overlap-unassessable parents contribute no invented score or characters to this point estimate and remain in coverage and selection sensitivity.
conditional_evaluation.operational_census: For every meeting, speaker cluster and full phase, report formed-parent counts and rates for final nonempty, empty, degraded accepted prefix, failed, expired and cancelled; raw outcome/failure-reason rows and unknown outcomes remain visible. Report declared input, real fed, synthetic EOF hangover, total fed, chunked, unprocessed, buffered, dropped and final-frame padding separately; source that never forms a parent cannot disappear into a parent denominator.
conditional_evaluation.execution_completed: Every declared full recording consumed exactly once: real fed samples equal declared input, with zero unprocessed or dropped real source samples. Reconcile processed samples against real input plus separately counted synthetic EOF hangover and final-frame padding, less buffered, unprocessed and dropped samples. Synthetic samples cannot mask real underfeed or overfeed. Every formed parent must be accounted by a unique provider terminal or owner retirement. Provider failure of an individual fully recorded parent is not source truncation. Missing parents, unobserved tail, budget truncation or an aborted recording remain incomplete.
conditional_evaluation.evaluation_valid: Execution completed; immutable accepted text conserved; real paired R0/R2 ownership records present; source/receipt/admission timing valid; no missing outcome or required guard computation, unhandled task failure, severe guard regression or changed source deadline. Explicitly computed overlap unassessability below does not alone invalidate a case or phase. Keep operational-clean status, evaluation validity and conditional support separate.

overlap_unassessable.eligibility: A nonempty authoritative accepted parent may receive this status only with real paired R0/R2 records, valid provenance, present guard computation, checked coverage_status=no_attributable_lexical_tokens, annotation_tokens>0, checked lexical_tokens=0, excluded.mixed>0, and both arm contamination records ineligible for no_attributable_accepted_text. These are measured multi-role temporal overlaps, not an inferred excuse for missing data.
overlap_unassessable.preservation: Keep the entire parent, accepted text, actual translations, source intervals, token identities, mixed/unaligned/punctuation counts and any unmapped pre-roll visible. Do not force a GT role, merge away a boundary, change a token timing or replace an unavailable score with zero.
overlap_unassessable.remaining_invalidity: Missing annotations or source/parent provenance, absent computation, missing paired records, pure unmapped/no-mixed primary coverage gaps, text loss/duplication, actual severe regression, timing failure and recording abort remain governed by the existing invalidity gates. Existing legitimate non-primary ambiguity remains exposed rather than newly invalidated.
overlap_unassessable.safety_truth: Per-parent grouping_safety_assessed stays false when no lexical token is uniquely attributable. Case/phase zero-lexical-coverage status also stays false. Any assessed safety statement is restricted to the uniquely attributable population, never a claim that overlapping unsupported text is safe.
overlap_unassessable.coverage: Persist status/reason, parent ID/source interval, checked lexical and excluded token/character counts. Per case, cluster and phase report qualified parent counts and accepted characters, with both formed-parent and accepted-nonempty-parent denominators and accepted-character coverage. Retain all other uncertainty categories; report scope explicitly.
overlap_unassessable.selection: Qualified unscorable parents stay in the existing formed-parent selection-bound missing set M, counted once, not in N. Report overlap-unassessable contributions to M separately. Keep the existing parent-standardized formula and labels; do not present those bounds as the lexical-weighted primary interval.
overlap_unassessable.data_reuse: Rescore the preserved clean ES2009a acquisition offline through the revised metrics, regenerating derived decisions/coverage from actual recorded parents and arm outputs. Preserve the original U9 scoring record and bytes, record acquisition versus evaluation revisions and raw hashes, and do not recollect provider output. Older pacing/provider-abort attempts remain invalid/excluded. No confirmatory result is inferred from this DEV revision.

sensitivity.name: complete_only
sensitivity.definition: Repeat the same character-weighted-within-cluster, equal-cluster primary estimate using complete accepted-text parents only. Report change from the primary estimate that includes authoritative degraded prefixes.

sensitivity.name: leave_one_cluster_out
sensitivity.definition: Report the primary cluster-mean delta after omitting each eligible cluster in turn; do not select a preferred subset.

sensitivity.name: formed_parent_selection_bounds
sensitivity.definition: Distinct diagnostic estimand, NOT a lexical-weighted primary confidence interval. In each cluster let S be the sum of paired per-parent contamination-proportion deltas over N scorable sequential accepted-text parents. Let M retain operationally unavailable/empty and unscorable accepted parents, explicitly including U10 overlap-unassessable parents once. Treat M conservatively as potentially relevant sequential parents with arbitrary delta in [-1,1]; report [(S-M)/(N+M),(S+M)/(N+M)], or null when N+M=0. Report equal-cluster means of endpoints, all N/M counts and the overlap-unassessable subset of M. Non-sequential scorable guards are not added to N. Do not invent missing character counts.

conditional_evaluation.sensitivity_interpretation: Bounds crossing zero expose selection fragility and forbid an unconditional effect claim; they do not erase a supported conditional result. Full-source truncation or unaccounted parents invalidates this formed-parent analysis. Preserve existing alignment/UNKNOWN harm bounds and all safety gates.
conditional_evaluation.superseded_history: U6/U7 automatic global inconclusive on any operationally unsuccessful or degraded parent was unmet and superseded by U8, not passed. U8-GUARD-2 strict primary-parent zero-coverage invalidation was unmet by two measured overlap-unassessable parents in clean ES2009a; U10 supersedes only that ambiguity case, not missing data/computation or genuine errors. All invalid-clock/provider-abort attempts and the 60s readiness probe remain excluded from the full evaluation dataset.

guard_oracle.scope: Preserve the existing severe-regression oracle and physical-identity restrictions. U10 changes only treatment/reporting of explicitly computed overlap-unassessable coverage and makes the uniquely GT-attributable effect scope explicit. The policy, source deadlines, point-estimate formula, sample and actual error gates are unchanged.
guard_oracle.ownership_semantics: A unit is a translation partition, not a physical-speaker identity. Positional OTHER identifiers may refer to the same person. R0 CURRENT is a synthetic baseline relation, not GT. Do not infer a physical reference from the first GT word after a silent native anchor or add post-hoc global speaker identification to this policy experiment.
guard_oracle.new_wrong_merge: For each arm independently, use the existing GT attribution and verified non-overlap sequential boundaries. A unit's evaluation reference is its first unambiguously attributed lexical token's GT role; lexical means containing an alphanumeric character. When the unit crosses a verified sequential GT boundary, its unambiguously attributed lexical tokens of other roles are wrong-merged. R2 wrong-token IDs absent from the R0 wrong-token set are newly introduced severe errors. UNKNOWN does not erase a mixed translation group. This retains the existing first-role contamination convention while excluding punctuation-only, mixed and unaligned tokens from the severe guard.
guard_oracle.same_speaker_cross_owner: Within an existing GT same-speaker-stratum parent, newly contrasting CURRENT and OTHER claims for unambiguously same-GT-speaker lexical tokens are a severe regression when R0 did not already make that contrast. Different positional identifiers alone, OTHER plus OTHER, UNKNOWN-only fragments and CURRENT plus UNKNOWN are not this severe event. Do not infer a same-speaker guard from only surviving tokens in a mixed or return span.
guard_oracle.reporting: Persist per-parent witnesses, newly wrong token and character counts, checked lexical/GT coverage, excluded mixed/unaligned/punctuation counts, and concrete-relation coverage. Aggregate real failures at case and phase level and feed evaluation validity and the canonical adoption decision. All-UNKNOWN output may have no concrete claims while still having assessed grouping safety when GT lexical coverage exists. Fragmentation and UNKNOWN remain separately visible costs.
guard_oracle.coverage_validity: A nonempty authoritative accepted parent without paired guard computation invalidates case and phase evaluation, including guard-only parents; missing computation is never zero errors. Zero uniquely attributable lexical coverage stays unassessed. A primary-pool parent satisfying conditional_evaluation.overlap_unassessable is outside point scoring and remains in coverage and conservative selection bounds without invalidating the whole case. Other primary zero-coverage/missing-input gaps remain invalid; legitimate non-primary ambiguity and empty/operationally unavailable parents retain their existing accounting.
guard_oracle.reference_input_integrity: Before paid execution, validate the declared AMI audio and all four A-D word-annotation files per meeting, parse annotations, require usable meeting-level GT, and record hashes and per-role word counts. An individual silent role need not have words. Missing annotation inputs are an execution prerequisite failure, not ordinary per-token alignment ambiguity. This input check does not inspect HOLDOUT model outcomes.
guard_oracle.design_evidence: Read-only inspection of committed bf0cd991 and the excluded 60s readiness probe established that units contain no physical-speaker slot, OTHER IDs are positional, the initial 80ms native anchor has no GT speech, and saved R2 units are UNKNOWN. These facts reject a concrete-relation-only or first-GT-speaker oracle; the guard instead measures the actual paired grouping contract.

confirmatory_decision.effect: Primary cluster-mean delta below zero with upper 95% interval below zero, improvement in at least 70 percent of eligible clusters, and benefit not explained solely by increased unassigned text; report absolute effect, not significance alone.
confirmatory_decision.safety: Zero missing/duplicate accepted text, zero mutation after admission or retired generation, and zero newly introduced severe guard errors. Severe means an unambiguously attributable lexical group newly assigned across a verified local speaker boundary or a previously safe same-speaker guard becoming cross-owner, not punctuation-only ambiguity.
confirmatory_decision.cost: No intentional PSEM wait or C5 extension. Every late operation is rejected and counted. Any gain purchased by uncertainty/fragmentation or measured admission delay is explicitly reported; a safety failure blocks adoption regardless of mean improvement.
possible_results: Conditionally supported for uniquely GT-attributable accepted ASR text within declared AMI/provider scope
Inconclusive due to sample, timing, alignment, runtime or budget gap
confirmatory_decision.no_expansion_after_result: Failed or inconclusive HOLDOUT results do not authorize another tuned pass under the same confirmatory label.
